subject: general
question: Which of the following events is the oldest one?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jallianwala Bagh Massacre**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre**

 
 
• The incident happened in the backdrop of protests against the Rowlatt Act and the subsequent arrest of Dr. Satyapal and Saifuddin Kichlew.
 
• To control the violence that emerged out after the arrest of the two nationalists, restrictions were imposed on the movement of people and holding the demonstrations in Amritsar.
 
• But on the day of Baisakhi, April 13, 1919, thousands of people were unaware of the restrictions gathered at Jallianwala Bagh.
 
• General Dyer following the orders of Michael O'Dwyer (Lt. Governor of Punjab) directed the troops to surround the gathering and shoot the people without any warning.
 
• As a result, thousands of people were killed and injured.
 
• After this incident, Rabindra Nath Tagore renounced his Knighthood.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi gave up the title of Kaiser-i-Hind and withdrew the Satyagrah against Rowlatt act.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poona Pact**

 
 
• The Poona Pact was an agreement between Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi, signed on **September 24, 1932**.
 
• It **addressed the issue of separate electorates for the "Depressed Classes" (now referred to as Scheduled Castes) in Ind**ia.
 
• The pact provided reserved seats for these classes in provincial legislatures within the general electorate rather than separate electorates.
 
 
 
• **Non-Cooperation Movement**
 
 
• Launched by Mahatma Gandhi, the Non-Cooperation Movement began in **1920**.
 
• It **was a mass protest against British rule, urging Indians to boycott British goods, institutions, and honors. **
 
• This movement was the first large-scale act of nonviolent resistance against colonial rule.
 
 
 
• **Quit India Movement**
 
 
• The Quit India Movement was launched on **August 8, 1942**, by the Indian National Congress under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• This** movement called for an immediate end to British r**ule in India and became one of the last major events in the struggle for Indian independence.
